cwe_assessments.review_comment: The added branch condition `if(dbits[i] == '1')` creates a secret-dependent control flow in the elliptic curve scalar multiplication. This introduces a timing side channel where the execution time of `pointMul` varies based on the bits of the secret scalar `d`, potentially allowing recovery of the private key. Replace the naive double-and-add algorithm with a constant-time implementation such as a Montgomery ladder, ensuring all operations execute in uniform time independent of secret data.
